sources.note: Main company page. Describes CCM Cloud, Drug Adherence, MTM, RPM platforms. Mentions physician/patient/pharmacy portals, FDA-approved device integration, 24/7 call center.
Mandatory disclosures page. Confirms product is 'Chronic Care Management Cloud, VERSION 21.9' with ONC HIT Modular EHR certification from October 14, 2021. Links to disclosure PDF.
About page. Describes mission, vision, core values. Emphasizes physician-centered approach, AI/ML capabilities, and HIPAA-compliant cloud infrastructure.
CCM services detail page. Lists care plan creation, 24/7 access, medication management, care transitions, structured EHR recording requirements. Most detailed description of data types managed.
RPM page. Describes RPM toolkit with roles (executives, providers, nurses, technicians, billing staff) but limited technical detail on devices or data types.
PCMH page. Describes patient-centered medical home support with Sargas automation, mHealth apps, and phone support.
Consumer-facing hru2day brand site. Lists CCM, RPM, MTM as three pillars. Claims 20,000+ patients, 200+ practices, 200,000+ interactions.
hru2day about page. Confirms partnership with physicians, hospitals, ACOs, FQHCs, home health agencies. Describes RPM physiologic data capture from FDA-approved devices.

hru2day CCM services page. Details structured recording of demographics, problems, medications, allergies. Describes care plan addressing physical, mental, cognitive, psychosocial, functional, environmental needs.
Healthcare Insights profile of hru2day. Notes company began in 2015, describes Triple Aim focus, AI/ML capabilities, and cloud-based interoperable infrastructure.
2022 press release. Details CCM/PCM/RPM services with specific CPT codes. Mentions PYA compliance verification. Describes revenue-sharing model with physician practices.
Same press release on GlobeNewsWire. Confirms Medicare billing compliance and service model details.
2015 press release about mobile app launch for Drug Adherence and CCM on Apple App Store and Google Play.
2015 press release about initial ONC HIT 2014 Edition Modular EHR certification for version 14.1.
Software Advice profile page. Returned 403 — no content accessible.
